meta.name: Pedal to Metal
meta.description: After a race they drive in ends fatally, friends Kike and Noche flee to Mexico City to hide, rebuild their lives and escape danger ... or at least try.

videos.title: Gasoline in the Blood
videos.overview: Friends Kike and Noche find themselves in a precarious situation after a race they're competing in ends in tragedy.

videos.title: Torque Town
videos.overview: As the young men get used to their new home and neighborhood, Kike is intrigued by Abi and her antics. Amparo finds a place to gamble.

videos.title: Being a Guerrero
videos.overview: Abi confronts her professor. While Kike auditions to enter a race called La Gorda, Noche worries about whether they should leave Mexico City.

videos.title: Divine Order
videos.overview: Abel's financial troubles cause him to get creative — and criminal — with his fundraising. The police look for the suspects who stole the captain's car.

videos.title: King of the Neighborhood
videos.overview: Kike is suspicious of Carcar's gifts, until one of his offers appears irresistible. Abel has an epiphany about where to build his church.

videos.title: Bad Trip
videos.overview: When Noche looks into the Karmann's steering issues, he makes a shocking discovery. An inquisitive Kike throws a party at Abi's to find answers.

videos.title: Guts and Fury
videos.overview: Noche connects with God, but is overwhelmed by guilt. Carcar takes Kike with him while conducting business, dispensing lessons on betrayal.

videos.title: Baptism by Fire
videos.overview: Frightened by Carcar's actions and how close he is getting to Kike, Amparo asks the guys to leave town with her. Noche prepares for his baptism.

videos.title: The Big One
videos.overview: The time has come for Kike and Abi to face off in the famous race, La Gorda, while they simultaneously attempt to pull off a heist against Carcar.

videos.title: Double Zero
videos.overview: Carcar tells Kike his suspicions have been aimed at the wrong target. Noche makes plans to escape with Rebeca. Abi seeks her revenge.
